fusions.name: Lopped and Regrown
fusions.desc: Hacks around you with the edge of your tail, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stillness, Then the Fall
fusions.desc: Holds still for 1 second, then drops a chop that deals 30 damage, always strikes critically, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut Loose
fusions.desc: Severs your own tail to get free: removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Knit Behind the Edge
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
